title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-11-07

ai_review.summary: A beautifully remastered 1969 soundboard captures a high‑energy show with a fiery The Other One and soaring Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The Charlie Miller master brings out remarkable clarity for a 1969 tape – crisp bass separation, clear organ intros and an overall clean mix that many reviewers call “beautiful sounding.”  Musically the night is uneven, with an average first set but a second half that shines thanks to a blistering The Other One suite, a two‑part Dark Star and a standout Lovelight.  Most listeners feel the performance is worth owning despite a few sloppy moments.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (12 out of 14) rate the recording 4‑5 stars, praising the remaster and key performances; a few low scores stem from non‑musical complaints.  Weighted assessment yields a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller’s CM remaster delivers clear, crisp sound for a 1969 SBD; bass separation is highlighted, organ intro on High Time is distinct, and overall mix is clean though some note the organ/guitar sit slightly low in the blend.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is considered average with a few missteps, but the second half builds momentum through Dark Star, The Other One suite and Lovelight, delivering strong peaks despite a lack of a formal set break.

band_member_comments.Phil: A Phil‑dominated passage in the first Dark Star is singled out, showing his powerful bass presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Organ intro on High Time praised; some listeners wish keyboards were a bit higher in the mix but overall they are clear and well‑defined.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum solos appear in Good Lovin' and The Other One; drums occasionally dominate the mix, adding to the live feel.
